# Command-line reference

The same tables print `cuervo --help` and `cuervo-tools --help`.

## cuervo

```
cuervo --game <dir> | --pack <game.pak> [options]
cuervo --demo vector|particles [options]
cuervo --svg <file> [options]
cuervo --svg <file.svg> --export <file.evec>
cuervo --font <file.ttf> --export <file.efont>
cuervo --dap
```

### Run a game

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--game <dir>` | Run the script project in &lt;dir&gt; (it holds project.toml). |
| `--pack <game.pak>` | Run an exported game; a game.pak next to the executable runs by itself. |
| `--dap` | Serve the Debug Adapter Protocol on stdin/stdout (the VS Code extension starts this). |
| `--backend vulkan\|gl\|webgpu` | Graphics backend. Without it: the platform default, with a fallback to GL. |
| `--quit-after <seconds>` | Exit after this many seconds (0 = run until closed). |
| `--vsync on\|off` | VSync (default on). |
| `--msaa 1\|2\|4\|8` | Multisample count for the demos and the SVG viewer. |
| `--scale fit\|integer\|stretch` | How the virtual screen fills the window (default fit). |
| `--font <file>` | Font for text (TTF/OTF or .efont); with --export, the font to import. |
| `--gl-es` | Ask the GL backend for an OpenGL ES 3.0 context (WebGL2's API). |
| `--no-audio` | Use the null audio backend: same triggers, no sound. |
| `--no-hot-reload` | Do not watch the scripts for changes. |
| `--jobs <N>` | Job system threads (default: CUERVO_JOBS, project.toml, else auto). The result is the same for every N. |
| `--simd off` | Run the scalar loops instead of the SIMD kernels (same results; for comparisons). |
| `--record <file.replay>` | Write every tick's input and state hash as a replay when the game ends. |
| `--net-host <port>` | Network play: wait for one peer on this UDP port and be player 0 (0 picks a free port and logs it). |
| `--net-join <host:port>` | Network play: join a --net-host game over UDP and be player 1. |
| `--net-mesh <host:port,...>` | Network play over UDP with 2 to 4 players and no server: every player's address in player order (the same list on every machine); needs --net-player. |
| `--net-player <i>` | Our index in the --net-mesh list (0-based). |
| `--net-relay <ws-url>` | Network play through a WebSocket relay (tools/net/relay.py); needs --net-room. Players are numbered in join order. |
| `--net-room <name>` | The relay room to join with --net-relay. |
| `--net-players <n>` | Players in a relay room (2 to 8, default 2). |
| `--net-mode lockstep\|rollback` | Network play: wait for every player's input (default) or predict and roll back. |
| `--profile` | Record engine zones and script functions and log both tables at exit. |
| `--trace <file.json>` | Like --profile, and write a Chrome trace (zones, job tasks, draw calls, Pluma heap) to the file at exit; open it in ui.perfetto.dev. |
| `--bench <seconds>` | Turn VSync off, warm up, then log frame-time stats over &lt;seconds&gt; and exit. |
| `--bench-warmup <seconds>` | Warm-up before --bench measures (default 3). |

### Automation

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--screenshot <file.ppm>` | Simulate one tick per frame up to the capture tick, write that frame as a PPM and exit. |
| `--screenshot-tick <n>` | The capture tick (default 240; 0 = the first rendered frame). Wins over CUERVO_SCREENSHOT_TICK. |
| `--press <list>` | Hold actions or push axes on given ticks: "60:ui_accept,10-20:ui_click,60-300:move=1,0". A tick is a number or a first-last range; action = name of an action, axis = name=x,y with values in [-1, 1]. |
| `--pointer <tick:x:y,...>` | Put the pointer at virtual pixel (x, y) from that tick on. |
| `--type <tick:text,...>` | Type text into a focused text field, one character per tick from that tick. |

### Demos and importers

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--demo vector\|particles` | Run an engine demo. |
| `--zoom <z>` | Start zoom of the vector demo or the SVG viewer. |
| `--intensity <x>` | Particles demo: bullet density multiplier. |
| `--no-hud` | Particles demo: draw no text. |
| `--svg <file.svg\|file.evec>` | Show a vector file in the SVG viewer. |
| `--instances <N>` | SVG viewer: draw N copies. |
| `--animate-zoom` | SVG viewer: zoom in and out continuously. |
| `--export <file.evec\|file.efont>` | With --svg: import to the binary format; with --font: import a font atlas. No window. |

### Help

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | Print this reference and exit. |

### Environment

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `CUERVO_SCREENSHOT <file.ppm>` | Same as --screenshot. |
| `CUERVO_SCREENSHOT_TICK <n>` | Capture tick for screenshots (default 240); --screenshot-tick overrides it. |
| `CUERVO_PRESS <list>` | Same as --press when the flag is absent. |
| `CUERVO_GL_ES 1` | Same as --gl-es. |
| `CUERVO_JOBS <N>` | Same as --jobs when the flag is absent. |
| `CUERVO_AUDIO null` | Use the null audio backend (also implied by the offscreen video driver). |
| `SDL_VIDEO_DRIVER offscreen` | SDL's video driver; offscreen gives a headless GL run. |

### Screenshot tick

`--screenshot` simulates exactly one tick per frame up to the capture tick, draws that state and exits, so both backends produce comparable images. The capture tick defaults to **240**; `--screenshot-tick <n>` or `CUERVO_SCREENSHOT_TICK=<n>` change it (0 is the very first rendered frame, and the flag wins over the variable).

### Scripted input (`--press`)

`--press` (or `CUERVO_PRESS`) is a comma-separated list. Each entry names a tick or an inclusive range of ticks, a colon, and what to do:

| Entry | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `60:ui_accept` | hold the action `ui_accept` on tick 60 |
| `10-20:ui_click` | hold `ui_click` for ticks 10 to 20 |
| `60-300:move=1,0` | push the two-dimensional axis `move` to x = 1, y = 0 for ticks 60 to 300 |

Axis values are in [-1, 1] and replace what the devices would give for those ticks; they are stored in the same input frames as device input, so a `--record`ed run replays them. An entry naming an unknown action or axis is ignored with a warning.

### Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| 0 | ok |
| 1 | any other failure (a bad flag, no device, an unwritable file); a replay mismatch also exits 1 |
| 2 | the scripts did not compile |
| 3 | a script panicked |

## cuervo-tools

```
cuervo-tools scene dump <file.scene> | build <file.txt> <file.scene> | load-text <file.txt> <file.scene> | migrate <dir> --text|--binary [--dry-run] | upgrade <file.scene> [<out.scene>]
cuervo-tools tier check <project> [--to compatible|full] [--platform linux|windows|web] | set <project> compatible|full [--force]
cuervo-tools shader build <project|file.glsl> [-o <out.cshader>]
cuervo-tools pack <project> -o <game.pak> [options]
cuervo-tools export <project> --platform linux|web|windows -o <dir> [options]
cuervo-tools pack-info <game.pak>
cuervo-tools fmt <file-or-project> [--check] [--write|-w]
cuervo-tools lsp [<project>] [--check-style|--no-check-style]
cuervo-tools docs [-o <file.md>] [--check <file.md>] [--check-coverage]
cuervo-tools cli-docs [-o <file.md>] [--check <file.md>]
cuervo-tools package new <dir> --name <name> [--version <x.y.z>] | check <dir>
cuervo-tools test <project-or-package> [--filter <substring>]
cuervo-tools plugin verify <dir> | publish <dir> | install <name>[@<range>] | list [options]
cuervo-tools license report <project>
```

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `scene` | Dump a scene file as text, build binary from text, normalize text, convert a folder, or upgrade a scene. |
| `tier` | Report whether a project fits a render tier on a platform, or change its tier. |
| `shader` | Precompile user shaders (.glsl) for the game: SPIR-V, GLSL ES and WGSL (docs/DESIGN.md 4.19). |
| `pack` | Pack a project into a game.pak. |
| `export` | Export a runnable game directory (docs/EXPORT.md). |
| `pack-info` | List the entries of a pack. |
| `fmt` | Format Pluma scripts. |
| `lsp` | Run the Pluma language server on stdio. |
| `docs` | Generate docs/API.md from the engine prelude. |
| `cli-docs` | Generate docs/CLI.md from the flag tables. |
| `package` | Create or check a script package. |
| `test` | Run the Pluma tests of a project or package. |
| `plugin` | Verify, publish, install and list plugins (--registry defaults to $CUERVO_REGISTRY). |
| `license` | List the licenses of the packages a project uses. |

### scene

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--text` | scene migrate: convert the scenes to text. |
| `--binary` | scene migrate: convert the scenes to binary. |
| `--dry-run` | scene migrate: list what would change without writing. |

### tier

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--to compatible\|full` | Check against this tier instead of the project's own. |
| `--platform linux\|windows\|web` | Check against this platform. |
| `--force` | tier set: change the tier even if the project does not fit it. |

### pack

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --out <game.pak>` | The pack to write (required). |
| `--platform linux\|web\|windows` | Target platform of the pack. |
| `--scripts source\|native` | Ship scripts as source or as native code (see --aot). |
| `--aot` | Compile the scripts to native code (same as --scripts native). |
| `--strip` | Leave out what the project does not use. |
| `--font <file>` | Font to pack (default: the engine's). |

### export

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --out <dir>` | The directory to export into (required). |
| `--platform linux\|web\|windows` | Target platform (required). |
| `--scripts source\|native` | Ship scripts as source or as native code. |
| `--aot` | Compile the scripts to native code. |
| `--strip` | Leave out what the project does not use. |
| `--font <file>` | Font to pack (default: the engine's). |
| `--runtime <path>` | The player executable to ship. |
| `--name <launcher>` | Name of the launcher. |
| `--engine auto\|full\|stripped` | Which engine build to ship (stripped players are built on demand). |
| `--cmake <path>` | cmake used to build a stripped player. |
| `--player-cache <dir>` | Where stripped players are cached. |
| `--no-verify` | Skip running the exported game once to compare its state hash. |
| `--emsdk <dir>` | Emscripten SDK for web stripped players. |
| `--host-build <dir>` | Host build directory for web stripped players. |

### fmt

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--check` | Report files that need formatting; write nothing (exit 1 if any). |
| `-w, --write` | Rewrite the files in place. |

### lsp

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--check-style` | Report style problems as diagnostics (default). |
| `--no-check-style` | Do not report style problems. |
| `--stdio` | Accepted for editors that pass it; stdio is the only transport. |
| `--clientProcessId <pid>` | Accepted for editors that pass it (--clientProcessId=&lt;pid&gt;); ignored. |

### docs

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --out <file.md>` | Write the API reference to a file instead of stdout. |
| `--check <file.md>` | Fail if the file differs from the generated reference. |
| `--check-coverage` | Fail if a public prelude symbol has no doc comment. |

### cli-docs

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --out <file.md>` | Write docs/CLI.md to a file instead of stdout. |
| `--check <file.md>` | Fail if the file differs from the generated reference. |

### package

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--name <name>` | Package name (required). |
| `--version <x.y.z>` | Package version (default 0.1.0). |

### test

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--filter <substring>` | Only run tests whose name contains the text. |

### plugin

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--registry <dir>` | The plugin registry (default $CUERVO_REGISTRY). |
| `--project <dir>` | plugin install: the project to add the plugin to. |

### General

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-h, --help` | Print this reference and exit. |

### Exit codes

0 ok, 1 the command failed or found a problem (a stale file, an unformatted script), 2 wrong usage.
